info.title: SeloNachipa Open Network API
info.description:
Open Commerce: list your products on the SeloNachipa marketplace for discovery — buyers are sent to your own checkout (checkoutUrl) and you keep your orders, payments and stock. Open Logistics: quote and request deliveries by the SeloNachipa rider network. The delivery fee is set by SeloNachipa: charge your buyer the quoted priceNgwee on your checkout; you owe it to SeloNachipa in full, and SeloNachipa splits it to the rider, platform and Social Fund.

Authentication: OAuth 2.0 client credentials. POST /oauth/token with your client_id and client_secret (server-side only — never in browser or mobile code), then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens last 1 hour.

Money is in ngwee (K 1.00 = 100). Every write needs an Idempotency-Key header. Sandbox products are never shown to buyers and sandbox deliveries never reach real riders — they move through every status automatically, one step a minute, firing your webhooks.
